approvalTimestampProvenance.note: The original user-message timestamp is unavailable and was not fabricated; approvedAt is the first durable coordinator recording/attestation time.

D20.notes: Hash-bound domain and real-UI execution confirms unsafe current-scene routing, cross-scene loss/overwrite, multi-parent/cycle paths, two deterministic 0xC00000FD exits, and six selected 0xC0000005 exits. The owner explicitly selected the bounded MGIF safety exception; this does not waive UI parity or later acceptance.

oracleTraces.behavior: Dropping a node onto its current parent preserves the document but clears redo and pushes exactly one Move command.
oracleTraces.notes: Executed in a fresh process against the fixed reference domain and exact UI command envelope; semantic and runtime hashes remain invariant while redo is cleared and one Move command is recorded.

oracleTraces.behavior: Dropping a root onto the current scene root preserves root order but records the reference Move command envelope.
oracleTraces.notes: Both current and non-current root-row command envelopes were executed in fresh processes; clicked sceneID is not passed and both are document/runtime no-ops with Move history.

oracleTraces.behavior: Cross-parent execute appends to the target tail; Undo appends to the old collection tail rather than restoring the original sibling slot.
oracleTraces.notes: Fresh-process domain execution confirms target-tail execute, old-parent-tail Undo, and target-tail Redo ordering.

oracleTraces.behavior: Deleting the only current-scene root keeps the node while clearing selection/redo and pushing Delete history; Undo restores selection and Redo clears it again.
oracleTraces.notes: The true unique-root command preserves the semantic glTF and matches selection/history, but contradicts the locked task prediction: sceneGraphRevision is 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 and runtime SHA-256 changes at every checkpoint. The modal itself was not executed.

oracleTraces.behavior: Escape while dragging, without same-frame release, clears selection and detaches while retaining preview TRS and adding no history entry.
oracleTraces.notes: Native UI evidence confirms visible Escape-only selection clearing, gizmo detach, retained preview TRS, and no visible Undo entry. Private gizmo state and definitive history-stack mutation remain later acceptance debt.

oracleTraces.behavior: Escape and left-button release in either same-frame order visibly clear selection, retain preview TRS, and leave Undo disabled; this conflicts with the earlier source prediction of one transform command.
oracleTraces.notes: Native execution of both event orders refutes the one-command source prediction. The visible result is authoritative, while private callback order and direct history memory remain bounded debt.

oracleTraces.behavior: Focus loss is traced separately for platforms that emit a synthetic release and platforms that do not.
oracleTraces.notes: Native GLFW/Win32 UI evidence covers real focus loss with no release, late release, synthetic renderer release, and release-before-loss partitions. Release recipient, private drag state, and definitive history remain bounded debt.

oracleTraces.behavior: Delayed single click, same-primitive toggle, blank click, and double click camera center/speed follow the reference timing and focus behavior.
oracleTraces.notes: Native UI evidence covers delayed single, same-primitive toggle, blank clear, Scene Graph focus, valid double-click reframe, and hit position/distance. Invalid/stale/hidden hits and numeric camera center/speed remain bounded debt.

oracleTraces.behavior: Every current/non-current scene row and node operation is traced from a pristine fixture for active scene 0 and active scene 1.
oracleTraces.notes: All 298 domain cells and all 298 fresh-process real GLFW/Win32 + Dear ImGui + Vulkan action paths are hash-bound, with 290 clean visible history sequences, two preserved stack overflows, six preserved access violations, and numeric exits for every cell. This is not 298 full UI state replays: exact serializer topology exists for only 7 cells/20 checkpoints and private state readbacks are zero.

oracleTraces.behavior: OS clipboard uses canonical gltf_material:<index> text with exact valid, malformed, out-of-range, and cross-document states.
oracleTraces.notes: Native UI evidence covers canonical copy/paste, named/wrong-prefix/nonnumeric tooltips, range and cross-document validation, Inspector assignment, and visibly disabled Undo. Decimal overflow and exact restoration of the pre-task clipboard remain bounded debt; D16's malformed-input safety rule remains authoritative for MGIF.
